crossRefs.note: Moses said, “Now Yahweh will give you meat to eat in the evening, and in the morning bread to satisfy you, because…
“The King will answer them, ‘Most certainly I tell you, because you did it to one of the least of these my brothers…
“Then he will answer them, saying, ‘Most certainly I tell you, because you didn’t do it to one of the least of these…
Remember the word that I said to you: ‘A servant is not greater than his lord.’ If they persecuted me, they will also…
But they will do all these things to you for my name’s sake, because they don’t know him who sent me.

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: “I said, ‘Who are you, Lord?’ “He said, ‘I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting.
translations.bsb: ‘Who are You, Lord?’ I asked. ‘I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting,’ the Lord replied.
translations.kjv: And I said, Who art thou, Lord? And he said, I am Jesus whom thou persecutest.
translations.asv: And I said, Who art thou, Lord? And the Lord said, I am Jesus whom thou persecutest.
